files.description: Full HTML of the ONC certification page for Net Health WoundExpert. Contains the only public EHI export documentation: a brief description stating the export produces a ZIP with CSV files, images, custom scans, an XLSX data dictionary, and a text summary.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'https://www.nethealth.com/drummond-certified-for-meaningful-use-woundexpert/' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:120.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/120.0' -o downloads/certification-page.html

files.description: Clean text extraction of the certification page content via WordPress REST API. Contains all page text with HTML tags stripped, preserving the EHI export description, certification details, and costs/considerations sections.
Full-page screenshot of the ONC certification page taken via browser. Shows the complete page layout including the EHI export section, certification details, and links to related pages.
